If you or your organisation would like to work with us, please get in touch.
Research students at Stellenbosch University with an interest in household
finance are welcome to email us to set up a meeting.

## Email

::: {.chf-contact}
[householdfinance@sun.ac.za](mailto:householdfinance@sun.ac.za)
:::

Stellenbosch Central, Stellenbosch 7600

Postal: Private Bag X1, Stellenbosch 7599, South Africa  
Telephone: +27 (0)21 808 2247
